taskDescription: Open Ignore Words Configuration from left navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Maker can reach the screen through full menu path
preconditions: Maker account exists with Configuration module access.
testSteps:
1. From the application dashboard, expand Configuration in the left navigation.
2. Select Sanctions Screening Configuration.
3. Click Screening – Ignore Words Configuration.
testData:
User role: Maker
Menu path: Configuration > Sanctions Screening Configuration > Screening – Ignore Words Configuration
expectedResult: Ignore Words Configuration listing loads. Active, Inactive, and Drafted Ignore Word tabs display record counts. Toolbar shows Export, Category Controls, Add Category, Bulk Upload, and Add Ignore Word. The ignore words table is populated for the default Active tab.

taskDescription: Verify breadcrumb text on page load
acceptanceCriteria: Breadcrumb shows correct hierarchy
preconditions: Maker is on the Ignore Words Configuration listing (Active tab).
testSteps:
1. Observe the breadcrumb at the top of the page.
2. Read the parent breadcrumb node.
3. Read the current page breadcrumb node.
testData: Expected breadcrumb: Sanctions Screening Configuration / Screening – Ignore Words Configuration
expectedResult: Breadcrumb reads 'Sanctions Screening Configuration / Screening – Ignore Words Configuration'. The current page node is visually distinguished as the active location.

taskDescription: Access page directly using valid deep link
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized user can open screen through direct URL
preconditions: Maker has an active session and has previously opened Ignore Words Configuration once in this browser.
testSteps:
1. While on Ignore Words Configuration, copy the browser URL.
2. Open a new browser tab and paste the URL.
3. Press Enter and wait for the page to finish loading.
testData:
User role: Maker
Access method: Direct URL
expectedResult: Listing opens without re-authentication. Breadcrumb, status tabs, toolbar, and table data match the original session. No permission or routing error is shown.

taskDescription: Refresh page and retain access
acceptanceCriteria: Screen remains accessible after browser refresh
preconditions: Maker is on Ignore Words Configuration with the Active tab selected.
testSteps:
1. Note the Active tab count and a visible row in the table.
2. Refresh the browser page.
3. Wait until the listing fully reloads.
4. Confirm the Active tab remains selected.
expectedResult: Session remains valid after refresh. Active tab stays selected, tab count is unchanged, and the table repopulates with the same active ignore words.

taskDescription: Open page using breadcrumb back navigation
acceptanceCriteria: User can navigate back to parent module and return
preconditions: Maker is on Ignore Words Configuration listing.
testSteps:
1. Click the Sanctions Screening Configuration breadcrumb link.
2. Confirm the parent configuration screen opens.
3. Return to Screening – Ignore Words Configuration using the left navigation.
expectedResult: Parent screen opens without error. Returning to Ignore Words Configuration restores the listing with tabs and table intact. No session timeout occurs.

taskDescription: Validate toolbar controls are visible on initial load
acceptanceCriteria: All major actions appear for Maker role
preconditions: Maker is on Ignore Words Configuration listing.
testSteps:
1. Review the toolbar on initial page load.
2. Confirm search field is present on the left.
3. Confirm Export, Category Controls, Add Category, Bulk Upload, and Add Ignore Word actions are visible on the right.
expectedResult: All primary toolbar controls are visible and enabled for the Maker role. Search accepts input. Action buttons are clickable.

taskDescription: Validate page title and tab counters load
acceptanceCriteria: Page header and tab counts load without placeholders
preconditions: At least one active, inactive, and drafted ignore word exist in the environment.
testSteps:
1. Open Ignore Words Configuration.
2. Read the count shown on the Active tab label.
3. Read the count on the Inactive tab label.
4. Read the count on the Drafted Ignore Word tab label.
5. Compare each count with the number of rows shown after selecting that tab.
testData: Expected tabs: Active, Inactive, Drafted Ignore Word
expectedResult: Each tab label count matches the number of records in that status. Counts update only after approved workflow transitions, not on draft save alone.

taskDescription: Verify unauthorized route access is blocked
acceptanceCriteria: User without module access cannot open the page
preconditions: Viewer account exists without Ignore Words Configuration permission.
testSteps:
1. Log in as Viewer.
2. Attempt to open Screening – Ignore Words Configuration via direct URL or menu.
testData: User role: Viewer (no configuration write/read permission)
expectedResult: Access is denied. User is redirected or shown an authorization message. Ignore words data is not exposed.

taskDescription: Verify Active tab default load behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Active tab is selected by default
preconditions: Maker is on Ignore Words Configuration.
testSteps:
1. Open the listing and observe the default tab on first load.
2. Verify the table shows only Active-status records.
3. Confirm each visible row displays an Active status badge.
expectedResult: Active tab is selected by default. Only approved, operational ignore words appear. Disable action is available in the Actions column.

taskDescription: Switch from Active to Inactive tab
acceptanceCriteria: Tab switch updates row status data correctly
preconditions: Inactive ignore words exist (e.g., 'and', 'the').
testSteps:
1. From the Active tab, click the Inactive tab.
2. Review the table contents and status badges.
testData: Sample inactive words: and, the, of, for
expectedResult: Inactive tab loads deactivated ignore words only. Each row shows Inactive status. Enable action is available instead of Disable.

taskDescription: Switch from Inactive to Drafted Ignore Word tab
acceptanceCriteria: Drafted tab shows only draft records
preconditions: At least one drafted ignore word exists (e.g., 'co' or 'son').
testSteps:
1. Click the Drafted Ignore Word tab.
2. Locate a drafted record and review its status and row actions.
expectedResult: Drafted tab shows entries saved as draft or returned after checker rejection. Status displays as Drafted. Submit action is available; word is not applied in live screening.

taskDescription: Validate tab counters against table row count
acceptanceCriteria: Selected tab count matches records fetched
preconditions: Environment contains records across Active, Inactive, and Drafted statuses.
testSteps:
1. Note the count on each status tab.
2. Select Active tab and count visible rows.
3. Repeat for Inactive and Drafted tabs.
testData: Tabs: Active, Inactive, Drafted Ignore Word
expectedResult: Tab label counts equal the row count in each respective table. Totals reconcile with backend status distribution.

taskDescription: Retain tab selection after search reset
acceptanceCriteria: Clearing search does not force tab reset
preconditions: Maker is on Inactive tab with search cleared.
testSteps:
1. Select the Inactive tab.
2. Enter 'limited' in the search field and confirm filtered results.
3. Clear the search field.
4. Verify the Inactive tab remains selected and the full inactive list returns.
testData:
Search term: limited
Starting tab: Inactive
expectedResult: Search filters within the current tab only. Clearing search restores the full inactive list without switching tabs.

taskDescription: Retain selected tab after page refresh
acceptanceCriteria: Current status context persists after refresh
preconditions: Maker is on Drafted Ignore Word tab.
testSteps:
1. Select the Drafted Ignore Word tab.
2. Refresh the browser.
3. After reload, confirm which tab is selected.
testData: Tab before refresh: Drafted Ignore Word
expectedResult: Page reloads successfully. Drafted Ignore Word tab remains selected and drafted records are still listed.

expectedResult: Empty-state message is shown (e.g., 'No ignore words found for this filter.'). Tab count displays (0). No erroneous data rows appear.

Tab: Active

taskDescription: Search by partial text value

Search input: llc

taskDescription: Clear search and restore full list

testSteps:

2. Compare the row count before search, after search, and after clear.

taskDescription: Search with special characters is handled safely

taskDescription: Search state remains when switching tabs
acceptanceCriteria: Search keyword is applied consistently on switched tab

taskDescription: Verify all table columns are displayed
acceptanceCriteria: Expected table headers are visible in order
preconditions: At least one ignore word exists on Active tab.
testSteps: 1. On Active tab, verify table column headers.

taskDescription: Sort Ignore Word/Phrase column ascending

taskDescription: Sort Category column ascending

preconditions: Words exist in multiple categories.
testSteps:
1. Sort by Category ascending.

taskDescription: Sort Risk Level column by configured ranking
acceptanceCriteria: Risk sorting follows Low-Medium-High logic

expectedResult: Risk Level sort uses configured severity ranking, not plain alphabetical order.

taskDescription: Sort Match Type column

2. Review row ordering.

taskDescription: Sort Created Date newest to oldest

taskDescription: Validate status badges by selected tab

2. Switch to Inactive and confirm Inactive badges.
3. Switch to Drafted and confirm Drafted badges.
expectedResult: Status badge on every row matches the selected tab. No cross-status records leak into a tab.

taskDescription: Retain column sort after switching status tabs

preconditions: Multiple ignore words exist on Active and Inactive tabs.
testSteps:
1. On Active tab, sort Category ascending.
2. Switch to Inactive tab.
3. Switch back to Active tab.
4. Verify sort indicator and row order on Active tab.
testData:
Initial tab: Active
Sort: Category ascending
expectedResult: Category ascending sort remains applied when returning to Active tab. Row order is unchanged from before the tab switch.

taskDescription: Verify row action column availability per tab
acceptanceCriteria: Actions column provides context-specific controls
preconditions: At least one record exists on each tab.
testSteps:
1. On Active tab, confirm Disable action is shown and Submit is absent.
2. On Inactive tab, confirm Enable action is shown.
3. On Drafted tab, confirm Submit action is shown and Disable/Enable are absent.
